text.title: 留在原地的一根木头
text.situation:
玻璃房外，一根倒木开始腐烂，一侧长着真菌。乔问为何没有清走。露丝说倒木对小生物有用，旁边小径仍保持畅通。牌子提醒不要尝不熟悉的真菌：有些有毒。牌后是上锁的园艺用品柜，包括杀虫剂。玛雅看到内容物可能有毒的警告，没有动柜子。

乔：每一种真菌都危害花园吗？
露丝：不是。这种真菌参与木头腐烂的过程。
玛雅：我们能碰用品吗？
露丝：不能。今天只看标签，不使用里面的东西。

paragraphs.en: Outside the conservatory, a fallen log had begun to decay. A fungus grew along one side. Jo asked why nobody had cleared it away. Ruth said the log was useful to small living things, and the path was kept clear beside it. A sign asked visitors not to taste unfamiliar fungi: some are poisonous. Beyond the sign stood a locked cupboard for gardening supplies, including pesticide. Maya read a label warning that its contents could be toxic; she left the cupboard alone.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Does every fungus harm the garden?
Ruth: No. This one is part of what happens as the wood decays.
Maya: May we handle the supplies?
Ruth: No. We are looking at the labels today, not using the contents.
